basis_note: Domestic passenger-vehicle wholesale (factory dispatches to dealers), as reported by OEM monthly releases and SIAM-sourced model data, compiled by Rushlane / Auto Punditz / Autocar India. Retail (FADA/Vahan) is not model-wise and is NOT mixed in.
period: 2026-04 to 2026-09 (April-September 2026, H1 FY2026-27). October 2026 data not yet published as of as_of date.

industry_total_units.note: Apr from Auto Punditz; May/Jun from Rushlane; Jul+Aug = Rushlane CY Q3 (13,62,429) minus Sep (4,57,604). Covers SIAM-reporting OEMs + MG/Kia/Toyota etc.; excludes BYD, VinFast, Tesla and luxury brands, which do not report monthly wholesale.

methodology: Rank = sum of available monthly wholesale units Apr-Sep 2026. Models with missing months are flagged (complete_6_months=false) and rank on available months only. 'months_derived' marks months computed arithmetically from reported totals (e.g. quarter minus other months), never estimated. Model-level numbers are secondary sources; brand totals match OEM press releases where checked (Maruti, Tata, Hyundai, Mahindra, Kia). EV variants of ICE nameplates (Nexon.ev, Punch.ev, Creta Electric, XUV 3XO EV, Carens Clavis EV, Syros EV etc.) are included in the parent model.
